project-brief.title: Project brief: Student Profile Page
project-brief.bodyMarkdown:
### Project Brief

**Scenario:** A student organization needs a small profile website that can become part of its member directory.

**Your role:** Junior web developer.

**Workspace:** Use the Full IDE Explorer. The project grows across `index.html`, `about.html`, `projects/robotics.html`, and a supplied `images/profile.png` asset.

**Deliverable:** A navigable profile site where every relative path resolves to a real workspace file and the supplied image appears with meaningful alternative text.

Complete the three steps in order. Each step reconstructs the previous milestone as its canonical starter state.
